desc: AgentBBS cross-host agent federation for ruflo (ADR-164). Phase 1 exposes room coordination — federation_bbs_register / federation_bbs_publish / federation_bbs_watch / federation_bbs_human_join. Phase 2 (v3.40.0) adds signed cross-host federation — federation_bbs_identity (persistent Ed25519 node identity), federation_bbs_peer_add (pin a peer by nodeId + public key), federation_bbs_peers (audit/unpin), federation_bbs_serve (read-only pull endpoint), and federation_bbs_sync (pull pinned peers and union-merge what verifies). As a mod (ADR-445 pattern): a tighten-only tool guard, a local slash command, and a status file the console shows.

desc: 5dive telemetry producer, seat panel, command surface and tool-call policy guard for Claude Code function hooks (early access). And it enforces a table-driven deny list over tool calls (policy/guard.json), so a rule that today costs every seat tokens on every turn and is caught after the fact is refused before the tool runs, with the reason handed to the model. name: creator-band

calls: command.register model.complete process.run state.get state.set store.get store.set ui.resolve widgets.card

name: cron-guard
desc: Asks before scheduled jobs or services are wiped or stopped: crontab -r, crontab replaced from stdin or a file, launchctl unload or bootout, systemctl stop, disable or mask.

name: csr-lens
hooks: agent.spawn command.run session.end session.measure session.send session.start tool.call turn.complete turn.start turn.step ui.close ui.focus ui.press ui.render{AbovePrompt} ui.render{Pane}

name: ctx-nudge
calls: session.usage ui.log ui.toast
desc: Reminds you to /clear or /compact when the context window passes 75 percent.

name: ctx-relay

calls: agent.list clock.after clock.every clock.now clock.sleep command.register command.run env.get fs.exists fs.list fs.read fs.write model.fork process.run prompt.submit session.cwd session.id session.messages session.usage settings.read state.get state.set store.get store.set ui.close ui.invalidate ui.log ui.open ui.panes ui.resolve ui.scroll ui.toast
desc: 提示框上方顯示每輪花費與距交接線的剩餘空間；越過自動交接線時倒數 60 秒，用 fork 產生交接檔後 /clear 並在新對話接續；新對話開場列出還沒人接手的交接檔，按 1 接續

name: curl-pipe-guard
desc: Asks before a download is piped into a shell or interpreter (curl | sh, wget -O- | bash, bash <(curl ...)).

name: customs-widget
hooks: command.run session.start tool.check ui.render{AbovePrompt} ui.render{Pane} ui.render{PromptHint}
calls: clock.now clock.sleep command.register fs.read http.fetch session.cwd state.get state.set store.get store.set ui.notice ui.resolve widgets.card
desc: Looks up every package Claude installs on npm or PyPI before the command runs, and holds the install for a yes when the name is missing or under 30 days old

name: daily-spend
calls: clock.after clock.every clock.now session.usage state.get state.set store.get store.set ui.log ui.resolve
desc: A band above the prompt with today's total cost across all your sessions.

name: db-reset-guard
desc: Asks before a framework wipes a database: prisma migrate reset, rails or rake db:drop and db:reset, alembic downgrade, django flush, supabase db reset, knex rollback --all.

name: debug-print-nudge
calls: session.cwd ui.log ui.toast
desc: At turn end, one toast naming the count of console.log, print(, debugger and dbg! lines your edits added this turn. Only code files count.

name: decision-compaction
calls: clock.after clock.sleep env.get http.fetch session.compact session.usage settings.read ui.log ui.toast
desc: Hands back the conversation itself in place of a compaction summary, less the tool calls and results a System One decision model judges no longer needed. The model can be TypeSafe Jev, Cloudflare Clef, Codiv OpenJev, Perplexity pplx-decider, OpenAI GPT-6 Luna, or Jev through OpenRouter, decisions-api.dev or decisionapi.net.

name: decision-model
calls: command.register decision.ask env.get http.fetch model.complete
desc: A decision model for other mods ($.decision.ask): typed questions about a state, answered by any System One endpoint (Jev by default) or a small Claude model.

name: deep-space
hooks: command.run session.start turn.complete turn.start ui.render{AbovePrompt} ui.render{InfoNotice} ui.render{PromptHint} ui.render{Spinner} ui.render{TurnDuration} ui.render{UserMessage}

draws: AbovePrompt InfoNotice PromptHint Spinner TurnDuration UserMessage
desc: A deep-space themed Claude Code: space verbs, a starfield with a pixel mascot, local Spotify controls and a violet palette.

name: deepgram-voice
hooks: audio.speak command.run prompt.submit session.start turn.complete turn.step ui.render{AbovePrompt} ui.render{AssistantMessage} ui.render{Pane} ui.render{ToolGroup} ui.render{ToolResult} ui.render{ToolUse} ui.render{TurnDuration} ui.render{UserMessage}

draws: AbovePrompt AssistantMessage Pane ToolGroup ToolResult ToolUse TurnDuration UserMessage
desc: Deepgram as Claude Code's voice: TTS readback of replies, overriding the system synthesizer

name: deploy-guard
desc: Asks before a production deploy: vercel --prod, netlify deploy --prod, firebase deploy, fly deploy, gcloud app deploy, eb deploy, heroku rollback, serverless deploy to prod.

name: deps
calls: clock.now command.register fs.read process.run session.cwd session.turns session.usage state.get state.set ui.copy ui.log ui.resolve
desc: Adds /deps: direct dependencies with versions from package.json, pyproject.toml, requirements.txt, go.mod and Cargo.toml at the repo root. No network. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: deskbar
hooks: command.run prompt.context prompt.submit session.start tool.call turn.complete ui.message ui.press ui.press{AbovePrompt} ui.render{AbovePrompt} ui.render{Pane}

desc: A desk for the Claude Code prompt: context weather, Gmail, calendar, tasks across sessions, notes, a music deck and a billable-hours timer

name: desktop-look

draws: AbovePrompt AssistantMessage ToolGroup ToolResult ToolUse UserMessage
desc: Make the terminal transcript look like the Claude Code apps: your prompts beside an orange bar, tool calls as one line with a state mark, lists set in with bullets, the text between tool calls set apart, and an info band

name: desktop-notify
calls: process.run ui.log
desc: Shows a desktop notification when Claude Code needs your input: osascript on macOS, notify-send elsewhere when it is installed. The text is the project name and a short status only.

name: dev-band
calls: clock.after clock.every clock.now process.run session.usage state.get state.set ui.log ui.resolve
desc: The developer band in one row above the prompt: git branch and changed files (read with git status), wall clock and session age, tool counts, and failed tool calls.

name: dev-dashboard
calls: clock.every command.register env.get http.fetch process.run session.usage state.get state.set store.get store.set ui.open ui.resolve
desc: Pane showing Claude service status, unpushed local repos, recent commits and GitHub pushes

name: dev-server-manager
hooks: command.run prompt.compose session.attach session.end session.start tool.call tool.check ui.render{Pane} ui.scroll{Pane}
calls: clock.after clock.every clock.now clock.sleep command.list command.register command.run env.get fs.exists fs.read process.run process.spawn prompt.fill session.id session.root session.surfaces state.get state.set store.delete store.get store.keys store.set tool.register ui.close ui.log ui.open ui.resolve ui.status ui.t
desc: A pane of the project's dev servers: start, restart and watch them, and fill a crash's error into the prompt.

name: diff-stats
calls: ui.log ui.resolve
desc: Edit and Write rows show a compact +12 -3 bar beside the file name: green for lines added, red for lines removed, up to 20 cells.

name: diff-widget
hooks: command.run session.start tool.call ui.render{AbovePrompt} ui.render{Pane} ui.render{PromptHint}
calls: command.register session.root state.get state.set store.get store.set ui.resolve widgets.card
desc: The last edit as a syntax-highlighted diff.

name: discord-notify
calls: clock.sleep http.fetch ui.log
desc: Posts to a Discord webhook when Claude Code needs your input. Sends the project name and a short status only. Does nothing until you set a webhook URL.

name: docker-guard
desc: Asks before Docker commands that delete data: system, volume or image prune, rm -f, volume rm and compose down -v.

name: docs-nudge
calls: session.cwd ui.log ui.toast
desc: At turn end, one toast when edits added exported code (an export statement in .ts or .js, or a public function signature) and no README or docs file was edited this session.

name: docstring-mode
desc: Every new or changed public function gets a short doc comment in the language's normal style.

name: done-ding
calls: audio.play audio.speak clock.after clock.now command.register http.fetch process.run session.repo session.root ui.toast
desc: Go make coffee: a desktop notification, a chime, and optionally a phone push when a long Claude turn finishes or Claude is waiting on you.

name: done-widget
hooks: command.run prompt.submit session.compact session.start tool.call turn.complete ui.render{AbovePrompt} ui.render{Pane} ui.render{PromptHint}
calls: command.register prompt.suggest state.get state.set store.get store.set tool.register ui.resolve widgets.card
desc: A definition of done you write once: Claude ticks each item with evidence through its tick tool, and is pulled up when it says done with items open

name: donut-widget
hooks: command.run session.start tool.call ui.render{AbovePrompt} ui.render{Pane} ui.render{PromptHint}
calls: clock.every command.register state.get state.set store.get store.set widgets.card widgets.picture
desc: The spinning 3D donut, drawn in pixels; it spins faster while tool calls are running.

name: earpiece-widget
hooks: agent.spawn command.run session.start tool.call turn.complete turn.start ui.render{AbovePrompt} ui.render{Pane} ui.render{PromptHint}
calls: agent.list clock.after clock.every clock.now command.register session.append session.messages state.get state.set store.get store.set ui.resolve widgets.card
desc: Every running subagent with the tool it is on and its last sentence, and /whisper slips one of them a note without stopping the turn

name: earshot-widget
hooks: command.run prompt.attachment prompt.submit session.start tool.call turn.complete turn.start turn.step ui.render{AbovePrompt} ui.render{Pane} ui.render{PromptHint}
calls: clock.every clock.now command.register state.get state.set store.get store.set ui.invalidate ui.resolve widgets.card
desc: Whether Claude has got the message you typed while it was working: how late a request first carried it, and what Claude changed before it heard you

name: echo-widget
calls: audio.play clock.every clock.now command.register session.usage state.get state.set store.get store.set ui.invalidate ui.resolve ui.toast
desc: Widgets above the prompt, each in its own box and switched on or off by a command: a pomodoro timer, a calendar and the context window as Tetris

name: effort-guard
hooks: command.run prompt.submit session.start tool.call turn.complete ui.render{AbovePrompt}
calls: command.register session.usage state.get state.set store.get store.set ui.resolve ui.toast
desc: Claude Code mod: context/token band, escalation signals and per-turn effort log.

name: eli5-mode
desc: Explains like the reader is new: analogies first, no jargon without a one-line definition.

name: env-check
calls: clock.now command.register fs.read process.run session.cwd session.turns session.usage state.get state.set ui.copy ui.log ui.resolve
desc: Adds /env-check: variable names in .env.example against .env at the git repo root, listing missing and extra names. Reads names only, never a value. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: env-example-nudge
calls: fs.exists fs.read session.cwd ui.log ui.toast
desc: At turn end, one toast when edits add a reference to an environment variable (process.env, os.environ, os.getenv, Deno.env) that .env.example does not list. Reads only .env.example names, never .env.

name: env-exfil-guard
desc: Asks before a command prints your environment, echoes a secret variable or sends local data to a remote host.

name: env-guard
calls: command.list fs.stat session.surfaces ui.ask ui.toast
desc: Asks you before Claude reads a .env or key file, and refuses when no one is there to answer.

name: envinfo
calls: clock.now command.register process.run session.turns session.usage state.get state.set ui.copy ui.log ui.resolve
desc: Adds /envinfo: versions of git, node, npm, python3, go, rustc and docker if installed, by running each (2 s limit), and the OS. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: epic-bar
hooks: session.end session.start tool.call turn.complete turn.start ui.render{AbovePrompt}
calls: clock.after clock.every clock.now process.run session.usage state.get state.set ui.log ui.resolve
desc: A band above the prompt with the progress of the epic you work on, or of the open epic nearest to done (bm-ooq ███████░ 7/8), read with bd. Hidden without epics or bd.

name: epics-pane
calls: clock.after clock.every clock.now command.register process.run session.cwd session.usage state.get state.set ui.close ui.log ui.open ui.panes ui.resolve
desc: A live side pane of each open beads epic: a bar of closed and total children, and a mark when it is ready to close. Read with bd, read-only. Open it with /epics.

name: equalizer-widget
hooks: command.run session.start tool.call ui.render{AbovePrompt} ui.render{Pane} ui.render{PromptHint}
calls: clock.every command.register state.get state.set store.get store.set widgets.card widgets.picture
desc: Level meters that jump with every tool call and fall back to rest.

name: error-meter
calls: clock.after clock.every clock.now session.usage state.get state.set ui.log ui.resolve
desc: A band above the prompt with how many tool calls failed this session (an error or a deny) and which tool failed last. Red from the first failure.

name: eta
hooks: command.run session.start tool.call turn.complete turn.start ui.render{Spinner}
calls: clock.every clock.now command.register state.get state.set store.get store.set
desc: Time left on the working turn, on the spinner line: from the task list's pace, else from how long your turns run. No model calls, no tokens. /eta turns it on or off.

name: eval-kernel
calls: agent.spawn clock.sleep command.register decision.ask http.fetch model.complete process.spawn session.cwd session.id tool.call tool.list tool.register ui.log
desc: A persistent JavaScript kernel the model drives with one `eval` tool: state survives between cells, and cells call Claude Code tools, models and subagents.

name: exit-badge
calls: ui.log ui.resolve
desc: A failed Bash row shows a small red badge with its exit code, for example exit 2.

name: explain-it
hooks: command.run prompt.submit session.start tool.call turn.complete ui.render{AbovePrompt} ui.render{Pane}
calls: command.register model.complete model.fork session.cwd state.get state.set store.get store.set ui.open ui.resolve ui.toast
desc: Explains what Claude just did, step by step, in plain English

name: explore-model
calls: ui.notice
desc: Pins the model that background recon subagents run on. An agent.spawn hook sets the Explore subagent's model to haiku, so a session driven by an expensive model stops billing its codebase searches at that tier, without shadowing the built-in agent definition and without the CLAUDE.md load a replacement definition would cost.

name: explore-pack
calls: clock.now command.register fs.read process.run session.cwd session.turns session.usage state.get state.set ui.copy ui.log ui.resolve
desc: Five read-only repo exploration commands in one mod: /tree, /deps, /authors, /scripts and /env-check. They read git and project files. They copy results to the clipboard.

name: factory-widget
calls: clock.every command.register fs.read session.root state.get state.set store.get store.set ui.resolve widgets.card
desc: The Widget Factory floor: each work order with its station and holder, what has shipped and what was turned back

name: fast-jev-compaction
calls: env.get http.fetch session.compact session.usage settings.read ui.log ui.toast
desc: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for Claude Code and Codex sessions.

name: file-explorer
hooks: command.run session.start turn.complete ui.close ui.focus{Pane} ui.message{Pane} ui.render{Pane} ui.scroll{Pane}
calls: clock.after clock.every command.register fs.list fs.read fs.stat fs.write process.run prompt.fill prompt.submit session.root state.get state.set ui.close ui.copy ui.invalidate ui.open ui.resolve ui.scroll ui.status ui.toast
desc: VS Code style file tree of the session's working directory in a pane

hooks: command.run prompt.submit session.start tool.call ui.close ui.message ui.render{Pane} ui.scroll

desc: A file tree and text editor in a pane: /editor, say "open the editor", or ask Claude to open a file in it

name: file-guard
calls: command.register env.get fs.stat session.cwd session.root store.get store.set ui.ask ui.toast
desc: Keeps Claude's file edits inside the project: refuses writes outside it (symlinks resolved), never lets a tool touch .git internals, and asks before it changes lockfiles, CI workflows, migrations or secrets.

name: file-links
calls: fs.stat prompt.fill session.cwd ui.log ui.resolve
desc: In Claude's replies, path/to/file.ts:42 references to files in your project become links. Click one to put @path/to/file.ts in the prompt.

name: file-owners
calls: clock.now command.register process.run session.cwd session.turns session.usage state.get state.set ui.copy ui.log ui.resolve
desc: Adds /owners <path>: the top 5 authors of a file or folder by lines, from git blame. Names only, never addresses. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: file-tree-pane
calls: command.register fs.list process.run prompt.fill prompt.read session.cwd session.repo ui.invalidate ui.open ui.resolve ui.toast
desc: Adds /tree: a side pane with a lazy file tree coloured by git status. Press a file to put @path in the prompt.

name: file-tree-widget
hooks: command.run session.start turn.complete ui.render{AbovePrompt} ui.render{Pane} ui.render{PromptHint}
calls: command.register fs.list session.root state.get state.set store.get store.set ui.resolve widgets.stack
desc: A file tree of the project directory with expandable folders.

name: files
calls: clock.every clock.now command.register env.get fs.list fs.read fs.stat process.run prompt.fill session.cwd session.root state.get state.set ui.open ui.panes ui.resolve ui.toast
desc: A file browser pane inside Claude Code: walk the project, read Markdown rendered, code highlighted, and pictures drawn in the terminal; see the files Claude touched this session.

name: files-pane
calls: clock.after clock.every clock.now command.register session.cwd session.usage state.get state.set ui.close ui.log ui.open ui.panes ui.resolve
desc: A live side pane of the files Claude read, edited or wrote this session, grouped by action with a count per file, newest first. Open it with /files.

name: files-touched
hooks: command.run session.start tool.call turn.start ui.render{AbovePrompt} ui.render{Pane}
calls: clock.now command.register fs.exists fs.read process.run prompt.fill session.root state.get state.set ui.close ui.copy ui.open ui.resolve ui.toast
desc: Every file Claude changed this session, at a glance: a one-line band above the prompt, /touched for a +/- table, and a pane that drops @file references into your prompt.

name: fireworks-widget
hooks: command.run session.start tool.call ui.render{AbovePrompt} ui.render{Pane} ui.render{PromptHint}
calls: clock.every clock.now command.register state.get state.set store.get store.set widgets.card widgets.picture
desc: A night sky that sets off fireworks when a test, lint or build run passes.

name: fleet
hooks: command.run session.start turn.complete ui.close ui.focus ui.render{AbovePrompt} ui.render{Pane}
calls: clock.after clock.every clock.now command.register command.run env.get fs.exists fs.list fs.read fs.stat fs.write model.complete process.run prompt.submit session.cwd session.id state.get state.set store.delete store.get store.set ui.copy ui.open ui.resolve ui.status ui.toast
desc: See every running Claude Code session and worktree at a glance: status, branch, uncommitted work, staleness

name: focus-pack
calls: session.cwd ui.log ui.toast
desc: Three quiet nudges in one mod: commit after 8 edits, TODO/FIXME/HACK lines added, and debug prints added.

name: footnotes-widget
hooks: command.run session.start turn.complete ui.render{AbovePrompt} ui.render{Pane} ui.render{PromptHint}
calls: command.register fs.exists fs.read process.run prompt.fill session.cwd session.repo state.get state.set store.get store.set ui.resolve widgets.card
desc: Checks every file path, cited line and code symbol in Claude's last reply against the working tree, with no model call, and flags the ones that are not there

name: forecast-widget
hooks: command.run session.start turn.complete ui.render{AbovePrompt} ui.render{Pane} ui.render{PromptHint}
calls: command.register session.usage state.get state.set store.get store.set ui.resolve ui.toast widgets.card
desc: Context growth per turn as a chart, with a prediction of how many turns are left before compaction.

name: fortune-widget
hooks: command.run session.start turn.start ui.render{AbovePrompt} ui.render{Pane} ui.render{PromptHint}
calls: command.register state.get state.set store.get store.set ui.resolve widgets.card
desc: A one-line fortune for the turn, drawn fresh each time you send a prompt.

name: fun-pack
desc: Fun habits in one install: caveman prose and gitmoji commit messages. They compose: caveman never touches commit messages.

name: galactic-battle
hooks: command.run session.end session.start tool.call turn.complete turn.start ui.message ui.render{AbovePrompt} ui.render{Spinner}
calls: audio.play clock.every clock.now command.register config.set env.get fs.stat process.run session.usage state.get state.set store.get store.set ui.invalidate ui.resolve
desc: Draws an animated space battle above the prompt while Claude works, driven by what Claude does (tool results, helpers), with a double-bladed lightsaber gauge for context and quota, blaster sounds and optional music.

name: garden-widget
hooks: command.run session.start tool.call ui.render{AbovePrompt} ui.render{Pane} ui.render{PromptHint}
calls: clock.after clock.now command.register state.get state.set store.get store.set ui.resolve widgets.card widgets.picture
desc: A plant that grows a leaf per tool call, flowers when checks pass and wilts when a call fails.

name: gear

desc: Routes each turn's reasoning effort with TypeSafe's Jev decision model, keeping the prompt cache (Claude Code 2.1.280+). Model routing is available but off by default and refused above maxSwitchTokens, since a model switch re-writes the whole context.

name: git-context
calls: process.run
desc: 会話の最初のメッセージに現在ブランチ・git status・main からの差分コミットを注入する

name: git-history-guard

desc: A live side pane, read with git: the branch, ahead and behind its upstream, changed files (staged and unstaged) and the last 5 commits. Refreshes after git commands and edits. Open it with /git.

name: git-pulse
calls: clock.after command.register process.run ui.status ui.toast
desc: Git status at a glance: branch, ahead/behind and changes on the status line, kept fresh as Claude edits, with a heads-up when the branch changes or a turn makes commits.

name: git-widget

desc: The scale, then the diet — and the diet only where the scale says it pays. Each model request inside a turn streams through one hook, whose stop chunk carries the four token counters and the model that answered, so the journal has a line per step, the main loop's and every subagent's apart, and names the cache misses where they happen. /clauget opens the report: the window and the cost, the bill of the prefix by provider with how often each provider's tools were called, the break-even of deferring, the instruction files, and every lever with what it saved and what it cost. Out of the box the mod measures and changes nothing. /clauget on, off or strict turns the levers on from the next session: a policy on the prefix decided once and never moved mid-session, tool results cut to the shape of their fat and filed whole so one Read undoes a cut, a small-prefix explorer agent, a lighter transcript for the compaction, economy tiers that tighten with the plan window, a forecast of when it fills, and prompts deferred to its reset. Each lever was measured on a real session; the ones that lost were closed and are named in the README. Nothing the mod writes reaches the model unless a lever puts it there, and then it is counted in the mod's own column.

desc: What another session sends lands in a tab instead of in the context. A peer's delivery is written to the mailbox under your home directory, listed in the Message tab beside the thread it belongs to, and announced in one line — and the session's transcript does not grow by a byte. The thread draws each message whole, wrapped to the column it has, with a Show more under the long ones that opens the rest in place: reading what was held has to be free, or holding it saved nothing. You read it and decide: Hand to Claude puts it in the context and starts a turn, which is the only moment it costs anything, or the field at the bottom answers it, calling SendMessage in the session's own loop so that no model turn is started to write three words. The left column lists the sessions running on this machine, read from the engine's own register: the name each goes by — the one /rename sets, and the one SendMessage takes — with the folder it works in and whether it is busy, this session named at the head of it and a refresh button (r) for the moment you rename one next door; the footer counts what was sent without a turn, what is held, and the bytes kept out of the transcript, three figures in two units and no total over them. It is the cockpit's fifth tab where a cockpit is seated, and opens a pane of its own where none is. /message opens it, /message hand hands everything held over at once, /message hold turns the holding off for the session, and /message who answers with the register of sessions this one can write to.

A band above the prompt shows the branch and who started it, open PRs or MRs per person, the branch's CI (passed, failed with the job, running), RAM and disk with warnings, the context level (fresh, mid, full), the running agent and its task, the current task step and the session cost; /mizan opens the details. desc: Claude as a small coworker in the terminal: an orange pixel-art Claude, two rows tall, in 132 frames. While a turn runs he sits beside the spinner in a scene for every spinner word (a thought bubble, a pen on a notepad, a book, a magnifying glass over text or over a globe, a laptop, a terminal, his own small helpers, a gear, a scroll for a skill, a plug for an MCP call); idle on the status row he breathes, blinks, strolls, yawns and sips a coffee, sweats near a full context and sleeps frosted once the prompt cache goes cold. While the main session rests and agents or workflows work in the background he minds them with a skit every few seconds: a rocket as they start, a paddle with how many are at work, a radar, a headset, a helper bringing a finished agent's report, juggling, bubble gum, popcorn, a paper plane, a plant that grows with the wait. The spinner word says what is happening (Reading register.ts, Running npm), and /coworker demo plays every animation once. Draws only; nothing reaches the model.

calls: env.get process.run ui.log
desc: Cleans up finished git worktrees as soon as a turn or a session ends. When a turn ends (the main session's or a subagent's), it runs `offcut apply --only auto --yes` for the session's repo in the background: a worktree goes only if it is clean, pushed, and its work is merged or eventlog says its agent is done. When the session ends, it runs once more a few seconds later, also clearing unused build caches, so the session's own worktree can go. Every removal is recorded for `offcut restore`. Inert when `offcut` is not installed, outside a git repo, or with OFFCUT=off.
